_about: Beowulf in English translations published before 1929, each its own work with its translator in the title, as with Andersen: John Lesslie Hall's verse (1892, held on main as `beowulf`), William Morris and A. J. Wyatt's (1895), Ernest J. B. Kirtlan's prose (1914) and Francis B. Gummere's verse (1909/1910). Clean Gutenberg text; US public domain.

beowulf-morris-wyatt: The Tale of Beowulf, tr. William Morris and A. J. Wyatt (1895)
beowulf-kirtlan: The Story of Beowulf, tr. Ernest J. B. Kirtlan (1914)

_held.beowulf-hall: PG 16328 (Beowulf, tr. J. Lesslie Hall, 1892) is already fetched on main as slug `beowulf` by fetch_sources.py; held there, not fetched twice (moved here at the coordinator's overlap check, 2026-10-03).

_excluded.beowulf-scholarship: Chambers's Beowulf: An Introduction (PG 34117), Olson's Hrolfs Saga and Beowulf (14878), Tinker's Translations of Beowulf (25942): about the poem, not the poem
_excluded.beowulf-elsewhere: Longfellow's Beowulf passage is on the Longfellow translator shelf (lane C)
_excluded.beowulf-ia-candidates: Earle (1892) and Tinker (1902) translations exist as IA scans; not taken in this batch
